messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "Novo Nordisk at 1-877-390-2760 or www.wegovypregnancyregistry.com"
set: ["Novo Nordisk at 1-877-390-2760 or www.wegovypregnancyregistry.com", "Novo Nordisk", "Novo Nordisk A/S, DK-2880 Bagsvaerd, Denmark", "swelling or blisters at the application site", "take in the morning or at night", "urinating less than usual or not at all", "FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088", "call healthcare provider or Poison Help line at 1-800-222-1222", "all at once", "dose is adjusted at intervals of a week or longer", "take other medications at least 2 hours before or after", "at least five days", "progress at regular visits", "subcutaneous use at home", "avoid eating or drinking for at least 15 minutes afterward", "uncommon at 0.4 mg"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
